1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nbd7 4.e4 e5 5.Nf.strategy: Brings the bishop to a safe square and prepares castling without weakening the centre. White's modest development keeps the d4 and e4 pawns protected and the space advantage intact, and leaves the question of the e5 tension open.

Completes the fianchetto and prepares castling. The bishop stands behind its own e5 pawn, so it works more as a defender than as an attacker for now. Black's position is solid and short of space, and the bishop becomes active only if the centre opens.
